constraints.title: Retired 2026-10-25: qualified nosemgrep does suppress; bare form also allowed

detector.message: retired 2026-10-25: 'nosemgrep: <rule-id>' suppresses the named rule and a bare 'nosemgrep' suppresses every rule on the line (semgrep 1.168.0, verified with a local rule); the earlier claim that the qualified form does not suppress was false. Prefer the qualified form (go.md).

constraints.title: shellcheck disable inline '-- comment' is invalid — put it on a separate line

detector.message: a 'shellcheck disable=<codes> -- comment' INLINE is invalid — the '--' comment must be on a SEPARATE line (go.md/shellcheck).
